text_en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ , by the will of God , according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus :
text_la: Paulus Apostolus Jesu Christi per voluntatem Dei, secundum promissionem vitæ, quæ est in Christo Jesu,
text_pt: Paulo, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, pela vontade de Deus, segundo a promessa da vida que está em Cristo Jesus,
text_el: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ κατ' ἐπαγγελίαν ζωῆς τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ

text_en: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son. Grace , mercy and peace, from God the Father and from Christ Jesus our Lord .
text_la: Timotheo carissimo filio : gratia, misericordia, pax a Deo Patre, et Christo Jesu Domino nostro.
text_pt: A Timóteo, meu amado filho: Graça, misericórdia, e paz da parte de Deus Pai, e da de Cristo Jesus, Senhor nosso.
text_el: Τιμοθέῳ ἀγαπητῷ τέκνῳ: χάρις, ἔλεος, εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.

text_en: I give thanks to God , whom I serve from my forefathers, with a pure conscience , that without ceasing I have a remembrance of you in my prayers , night and day.
text_la: Gratias ago Deo, cui servio a progenitoribus in conscientia pura, quod sine intermissione habeam tui memoriam in orationibus meis, nocte ac die
text_pt: Dou graças a Deus, a quem desde os meus antepassados sirvo com uma consciência pura, de que sem cessar faço memória de ti nas minhas orações noite e dia;
text_el: Χάριν ἔχω τῷ θεῷ, ᾧ λατρεύω ἀπὸ προγόνων ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει, ὡς ἀδιάλειπτον ἔχω τὴν περὶ σοῦ μνείαν ἐν ταῖς δεήσεσίν μου νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας,

text_en: Desiring to see you, being mindful of your tears, that I may be filled with joy :
text_la: desiderans te videre, memor lacrimarum tuarum, ut gaudio implear,
text_pt: Desejando muito ver-te, lembrando-me das tuas lágrimas, para me encher de gozo;
text_el: ἐπιποθῶν σε ἰδεῖν, μεμνημένος σου τῶν δακρύων, ἵνα χαρᾶς πληρωθῶ,

text_en: Calling to mind that faith which is in you unfeigned, which also dwelt first in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice, and I am certain that in you also.
text_la: recordationem accipiens ejus fidei, quæ est in te non ficta, quæ et habitavit primum in avia tua Loide, et matre tua Eunice, certus sum autem quod et in te.
text_pt: Trazendo à memória a fé não fingida que em ti há, a qual habitou primeiro em tua avó Lóide, e em tua mãe Eunice, e estou certo de que também habita em ti.
text_el: ὑπόμνησιν λαβὼν τῆς ἐν σοὶ ἀνυποκρίτου πίστεως, ἥτις ἐνῴκησεν πρῶτον ἐν τῇ μάμμῃ σου Λωΐδι καὶ τῇ μητρί σου Εὐνίκῃ, πέπεισμαι δὲ ὅτι καὶ ἐν σοί.

text_en: For which cause I admonish you that you stir up the grace of God which is in you by the imposition of my hands .
text_la: Propter quam causam admoneo te ut resuscites gratiam Dei, quæ est in te per impositionem manuum mearum.
text_pt: Por cujo motivo te lembro que despertes o dom de Deus que existe em ti pela imposição das minhas mãos.
text_el: δι' ἣν αἰτίαν ἀναμιμνῄσκω σε ἀναζωπυρεῖν τὸ χάρισμα τοῦ θεοῦ, ὅ ἐστιν ἐν σοὶ διὰ τῆς ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν μου:

text_en: For God has not given us the spirit of fear : but of power and of love and of sobriety.
text_la: Non enim dedit nobis Deus spiritum timoris : sed virtutis, et dilectionis, et sobrietatis.
text_pt: Porque Deus não nos deu o espírito de temor, mas de fortaleza, e de amor, e de moderação.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν ὁ θεὸς πνεῦμα δειλίας, ἀλλὰ δυνάμεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ σωφρονισμοῦ.

text_en: Be not therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord , nor of me his prisoner: but labour with the gospel , according to the power of God .
text_la: Noli itaque erubescere testimonium Domini nostri, neque me vinctum ejus : sed collabora Evangelio secundum virtutem Dei:
text_pt: Portanto, não te envergonhes do testemunho de nosso Senhor, nem de mim, que sou prisioneiro seu; antes participa das aflições do evangelho segundo o poder de Deus,
text_el: μὴ οὖν ἐπαισχυνθῇς τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μηδὲ ἐμὲ τὸν δέσμιον αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ συγκακοπάθησον τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ κατὰ δύναμιν θεοῦ,

text_en: Who has delivered us and called us by his holy calling, not according to our own works , but according to his own purpose and grace , which was given us in Christ Jesus before the times of the world:
text_la: qui nos liberavit, et vocavit vocatione sua sancta, non secundum opera nostra, sed secundum propositum suum, et gratiam, quæ data est nobis in Christo Jesu ante tempora sæcularia.
text_pt: Que nos salvou, e chamou com uma santa vocação; não segundo as nossas obras, mas segundo o seu próprio propósito e graça que nos foi dada em Cristo Jesus antes dos tempos dos séculos;
text_el: τοῦ σώσαντος ἡμᾶς καὶ καλέσαντος κλήσει ἁγίᾳ, οὐ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ἡμῶν ἀλλὰ κατὰ ἰδίαν πρόθεσιν καὶ χάριν, τὴν δοθεῖσαν ἡμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων,

text_en: But is now made manifest by the illumination of our Saviour Jesus Christ , who has destroyed death and has brought to light life and incorruption by the gospel .
text_la: Manifestata est autem nunc per illuminationem Salvatoris nostri Jesu Christi, qui destruxit quidem mortem, illuminavit autem vitam, et incorruptionem per Evangelium:
text_pt: E que é manifesta agora pela aparição de nosso Salvador Jesus Cristo, o qual aboliu a morte, e trouxe à luz a vida e a incorrupção pelo evangelho;
text_el: φανερωθεῖσαν δὲ νῦν διὰ τῆς ἐπιφανείας τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, καταργήσαντος μὲν τὸν θάνατον φωτίσαντος δὲ ζωὴν καὶ ἀφθαρσίαν διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,

text_en: Wherein I am appointed a preacher and an apostle and teacher of the Gentiles .
text_la: in quo positus sum ego prædicator, et Apostolus, et magister gentium.
text_pt: Para o que fui constituído pregador, e apóstolo, e doutor dos gentios.
text_el: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κῆρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος καὶ διδάσκαλος.

text_en: For which cause, I also suffer these things: but I am not ashamed. For I know whom I have believed and I am certain that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him, against that day.
text_la: Ob quam causam etiam hæc patior, sed non confundor. Scio enim cui credidi, et certus sum quia potens est depositum meum servare in illum diem.
text_pt: Por cuja causa padeço também isto, mas não me envergonho; porque eu sei em quem tenho crido, e estou certo de que é poderoso para guardar o meu depósito até àquele dia.
text_el: δι' ἣν αἰτίαν καὶ ταῦτα πάσχω, ἀλλ' οὐκ ἐπαισχύνομαι, οἶδα γὰρ ᾧ πεπίστευκα, καὶ πέπεισμαι ὅτι δυνατός ἐστιν τὴν παραθήκην μου φυλάξαι εἰς ἐκείνην τὴν ἡμέραν.

text_en: Hold the form of sound words which you have heard of me: in faith and in the love which is in Christ Jesus .
text_la: Formam habe sanorum verborum, quæ a me audisti in fide, et in dilectione in Christo Jesu.
text_pt: Conserva o modelo das sãs palavras que de mim tens ouvido, na fé e no amor que há em Cristo Jesus.
text_el: ὑποτύπωσιν ἔχε ὑγιαινόντων λόγων ὧν παρ' ἐμοῦ ἤκουσας ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ:

text_en: Keep the good thing committed to your trust by the Holy Ghost who dwells in us.
text_la: Bonum depositum custodi per Spiritum Sanctum, qui habitat in nobis.
text_pt: Guarda o bom depósito pelo Espírito Santo que habita em nós.
text_el: τὴν καλὴν παραθήκην φύλαξον διὰ πνεύματος ἁγίου τοῦ ἐνοικοῦντος ἐν ἡμῖν.

text_en: You know this, that all they who are in Asia are turned away from me: of whom are Phigellus and Hermogenes.
text_la: Scis hoc, quod aversi sunt a me omnes, qui in Asia sunt, ex quibus est Phigellus, et Hermogenes.
text_pt: Bem sabes isto, que os que estão na Ásia todos se apartaram de mim; entre os quais foram Figelo e Hermógenes.
text_el: οἶδας τοῦτο, ὅτι ἀπεστράφησάν με πάντες οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ, ὧν ἐστιν Φύγελος καὶ Ἑρμογένης.

text_en: The Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus: because he has often refreshed me and has not been ashamed of my chain:
text_la: Det misericordiam Dominus Onesiphori domui : quia sæpe me refrigeravit, et catenam meam non erubuit:
text_pt: O Senhor conceda misericórdia à casa de Onesíforo, porque muitas vezes me recreou, e não se envergonhou das minhas cadeias.
text_el: δῴη ἔλεος ὁ κύριος τῷ Ὀνησιφόρου οἴκῳ, ὅτι πολλάκις με ἀνέψυξεν καὶ τὴν ἅλυσίν μου οὐκ ἐπαισχύνθη,

text_en: But when he had come to Rome , he carefully sought me and found me.
text_la: sed cum Romam venisset, sollicite me quæsivit, et invenit.
text_pt: Antes, vindo ele a Roma, com muito cuidado me procurou e me achou.
text_el: ἀλλὰ γενόμενος ἐν Ῥώμῃ σπουδαίως ἐζήτησέν με καὶ εὗρεν

text_en: The Lord grant unto him to find mercy of the Lord in that day. And in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus , you very well know .
text_la: Det illi Dominus invenire misericordiam a Domino in illa die. Et quanta Ephesi ministravit mihi, tu melius nosti.
text_pt: O Senhor lhe conceda que naquele dia ache misericórdia diante do Senhor. E, quanto me ajudou em Éfeso, melhor o sabes tu.
text_el: δῴη αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος εὑρεῖν ἔλεος παρὰ κυρίου ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ. καὶ ὅσα ἐν Ἐφέσῳ διηκόνησεν, Βέλτιον σὺ γινώσκεις.

text_en: You therefore, my son, be strong in Christ Jesus :
text_la: Tu ergo fili mi, confortare in gratia, quæ est in Christo Jesu:
text_pt: Tu, pois, meu filho, fortifica-te na graça que há em Cristo Jesus.
text_el: Σὺ οὖν, τέκνον μου, ἐνδυναμοῦ ἐν τῇ χάριτι τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: And the things which you have heard of me by many witnesses , the same commend to faithful men who shall be fit to teach others also.
text_la: et quæ audisti a me per multos testes, hæc commenda fidelibus hominibus, qui idonei erant et alios docere.
text_pt: E o que de mim, entre muitas testemunhas, ouviste, confia-o a homens fiéis, que sejam idôneos para também ensinarem os outros.
text_el: καὶ ἃ ἤκουσας παρ' ἐμοῦ διὰ πολλῶν μαρτύρων, ταῦτα παράθου πιστοῖς ἀνθρώποις, οἵτινες ἱκανοὶ ἔσονται καὶ ἑτέρους διδάξαι.

text_en: Labour as a good soldier of Christ Jesus .
text_la: Labora sicut bonus miles Christi Jesu.
text_pt: Tu pois, sofre as aflições, como bom soldado de Jesus Cristo.
text_el: συγκακοπάθησον ὡς καλὸς στρατιώτης Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: No man , being a soldier to God , entangles himself with secular businesses: that he may please him to whom he has engaged himself.
text_la: Nemo militans Deo implicat se negotiis sæcularibus : ut ei placeat, cui se probavit.
text_pt: Ninguém que milita se embaraça com negócios desta vida, a fim de agradar àquele que o alistou para a guerra.
text_el: οὐδεὶς στρατευόμενος ἐμπλέκεται ταῖς τοῦ βίου πραγματείαις, ἵνα τῷ στρατολογήσαντι ἀρέσῃ:

text_en: For he also that strives for the mastery is not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
text_la: Nam et qui certat in agone, non coronatur nisi legitime certaverit.
text_pt: E, se alguém também milita, não é coroado se não militar legitimamente.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ ἀθλῇ τις, οὐ στεφανοῦται ἐὰν μὴ νομίμως ἀθλήσῃ.

text_en: The husbandman that labours must first partake of the fruits.
text_la: Laborantem agricolam oportet primum de fructibus percipere.
text_pt: O lavrador que trabalha deve ser o primeiro a gozar dos frutos.
text_el: τὸν κοπιῶντα γεωργὸν δεῖ πρῶτον τῶν καρπῶν μεταλαμβάνειν.

text_en: Understand what I say: for the Lord will give you in all things understanding.
text_la: Intellige quæ dico : dabit enim tibi Dominus in omnibus intellectum.
text_pt: Considera o que digo, e o Senhor te dê entendimento em tudo.
text_el: νόει ὃ λέγω: δώσει γάρ σοι ὁ κύριος σύνεσιν ἐν πᾶσιν.

text_en: Be mindful that the Lord Jesus Christ is risen again from the dead , of the seed of David , according to my gospel :
text_la: Memor esto Dominum Jesum Christum resurrexisse a mortuis ex semine David, secundum Evangelium meum,
text_pt: Lembra-te de que Jesus Cristo, que é da descendência de Davi, ressuscitou dentre os mortos, segundo o meu evangelho;
text_el: Μνημόνευε Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐγηγερμένον ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐκ σπέρματος Δαυίδ, κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν μου:

text_en: Wherein I labour even unto bands, as an evildoer. But the word of God is not bound.
text_la: in quo laboro usque ad vincula, quasi male operans : sed verbum Dei non est alligatum.
text_pt: Por isso sofro trabalhos e até prisões, como um malfeitor; mas a palavra de Deus não está presa.
text_el: ἐν ᾧ κακοπαθῶ μέχρι δεσμῶν ὡς κακοῦργος, ἀλλὰ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ οὐ δέδεται.

text_en: Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the elect , that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus , with heavenly glory .
text_la: Ideo omnia sustineo propter electos, ut et ipsi salutem consequantur, quæ est in Christo Jesu, cum gloria cælesti.
text_pt: Portanto, tudo sofro por amor dos escolhidos, para que também eles alcancem a salvação que está em Cristo Jesus com glória eterna.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο πάντα ὑπομένω διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς, ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ σωτηρίας τύχωσιν τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ μετὰ δόξης αἰωνίου.

text_en: A faithful saying: for if we be dead with him , we shall live also with him .
text_la: Fidelis sermo : nam si commortui sumus, et convivemus:
text_pt: Palavra fiel é esta: que, se morrermos com ele, também com ele viveremos;
text_el: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος: εἰ γὰρ συναπεθάνομεν, καὶ συζήσομεν:

text_en: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him. If we deny him, he will also deny us.
text_la: si sustinebimus, et conregnabimus : si negaverimus, et ille negabit nos:
text_pt: Se sofrermos, também com ele reinaremos; se o negarmos, também ele nos negará;
text_el: εἰ ὑπομένομεν, καὶ συμβασιλεύσομεν: εἰ ἀρνησόμεθα, κἀκεῖνος ἀρνήσεται ἡμᾶς:

text_en: If we believe not, he continues faithful, he cannot deny himself.
text_la: si non credimus, ille fidelis permanet, negare seipsum non potest.
text_pt: Se formos infiéis, ele permanece fiel; não pode negar-se a si mesmo.
text_el: εἰ ἀπιστοῦμεν, ἐκεῖνος πιστὸς μένει, ἀρνήσασθαι γὰρ ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται.

text_en: Of these things put them in mind , charging them before the Lord . Contend not in words: for it is to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
text_la: Hæc commone, testificans coram Domino. Noli contendere verbis : ad nihil enim utile est, nisi ad subversionem audientium.
text_pt: Traze estas coisas à memória, ordenando-lhes diante do Senhor que não tenham contendas de palavras, que para nada aproveitam e são para perversão dos ouvintes.
text_el: Ταῦτα ὑπομίμνῃσκε, διαμαρτυρόμενος ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ μὴ λογομαχεῖν, ἐπ' οὐδὲν χρήσιμον, ἐπὶ καταστροφῇ τῶν ἀκουόντων.

text_en: Carefully study to present yourself approved unto God , a workman that needs not to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth .
text_la: Sollicite cura teipsum probabilem exhibere Deo, operarium inconfusibilem, recte tractantem verbum veritatis.
text_pt: Procura apresentar-te a Deus aprovado, como obreiro que não tem de que se envergonhar, que maneja bem a palavra da verdade.
text_el: σπούδασον σεαυτὸν δόκιμον παραστῆσαι τῷ θεῷ, ἐργάτην ἀνεπαίσχυντον, ὀρθοτομοῦντα τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας.

text_en: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they grow much towards ungodliness.
text_la: Profana autem et vaniloquia devita : multum enim proficiunt ad impietatem:
text_pt: Mas evita os falatórios profanos, porque produzirão maior impiedade.
text_el: τὰς δὲ βεβήλους κενοφωνίας περιΐστασο: ἐπὶ πλεῖον γὰρ προκόψουσιν ἀσεβείας,

text_en: And their speech spreads like a canker: of whom are Hymeneus and Philetus:
text_la: et sermo eorum ut cancer serpit : ex quibus est Hymenæus et Philetus,
text_pt: E a palavra desses roerá como gangrena; entre os quais são Himeneu e Fileto;
text_el: καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτῶν ὡς γάγγραινα νομὴν ἕξει: ὧν ἐστιν Ὑμέναιος καὶ Φίλητος,

text_en: Who have erred from the truth , saying that the resurrection is past already, and have subverted the faith of some.
text_la: qui a veritate exciderunt, dicentes resurrectionem esse jam factam, et subverterunt quorumdam fidem.
text_pt: Os quais se desviaram da verdade, dizendo que a ressurreição era já feita, e perverteram a fé de alguns.
text_el: οἵτινες περὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἠστόχησαν, λέγοντες ἀνάστασιν ἤδη γεγονέναι, καὶ ἀνατρέπουσιν τήν τινων πίστιν.

text_en: But the sure foundation of God stands firm, having this seal: the Lord knows who are his; and let every one depart from iniquity who names the name of the Lord .
text_la: Sed firmum fundamentum Dei stat, habens signaculum hoc : cognovit Dominus qui sunt ejus, et discedat ab iniquitate omnis qui nominat nomen Domini.
text_pt: Todavia o fundamento de Deus fica firme, tendo este selo: O Senhor conhece os que são seus, e qualquer que profere o nome de Cristo aparte-se da iniqüidade.
text_el: ὁ μέντοι στερεὸς θεμέλιος τοῦ θεοῦ ἕστηκεν, ἔχων τὴν σφραγῖδα ταύτην: ἔγνω κύριος τοὺς ὄντας αὐτοῦ, καί, ἀποστήτω ἀπὸ ἀδικίας πᾶς ὁ ὀνομάζων τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου.

text_en: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth: and some indeed unto honour , but some unto dishonour.
text_la: In magna autem domo non solum sunt vasa aurea, et argentea, sed et lignea, et fictilia : et quædam quidem in honorem, quædam autem in contumeliam.
text_pt: Ora, numa grande casa não somente há vasos de ouro e de prata, mas também de pau e de barro; uns para honra, outros, porém, para desonra.
text_el: ἐν μεγάλῃ δὲ οἰκίᾳ οὐκ ἔστιν μόνον σκεύη χρυσᾶ καὶ ἀργυρᾶ ἀλλὰ καὶ ξύλινα καὶ ὀστράκινα, καὶ ἃ μὲν εἰς τιμὴν ἃ δὲ εἰς ἀτιμίαν:

text_en: If any man therefore shall cleanse himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour , sanctified and profitable to the Lord , prepared unto every good work .
text_la: Si quis ergo emundaverit se ab istis, erit vas in honorem sanctificatum, et utile Domino ad omne opus bonum paratum.
text_pt: De sorte que, se alguém se purificar destas coisas, será vaso para honra, santificado e idôneo para uso do Senhor, e preparado para toda a boa obra.
text_el: ἐὰν οὖν τις ἐκκαθάρῃ ἑαυτὸν ἀπὸ τούτων, ἔσται σκεῦος εἰς τιμήν, ἡγιασμένον, εὔχρηστον τῷ δεσπότῃ, εἰς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἡτοιμασμένον.

text_en: But flee youthful desires, and pursue justice , faith , charity and peace with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
text_la: Juvenilia autem desideria fuge, sectare vero justitiam, fidem, spem, caritatem, et pacem cum iis qui invocant Dominum de corde puro.
text_pt: Foge também das paixões da mocidade; e segue a justiça, a fé, o amor, e a paz com os que, com um coração puro, invocam o Senhor.
text_el: τὰς δὲ νεωτερικὰς ἐπιθυμίας φεῦγε, δίωκε δὲ δικαιοσύνην, πίστιν, ἀγάπην, εἰρήνην μετὰ τῶν ἐπικαλουμένων τὸν κύριον ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας.

text_en: And avoid foolish and unlearned questions, knowing that they beget strifes.
text_la: Stultas autem et sine disciplina quæstiones devita : sciens quia generant lites.
text_pt: E rejeita as questões loucas, e sem instrução, sabendo que produzem contendas.
text_el: τὰς δὲ μωρὰς καὶ ἀπαιδεύτους ζητήσεις παραιτοῦ, εἰδὼς ὅτι γεννῶσιν μάχας:

text_en: But the servant of the Lord must not wrangle: but be mild toward all men , apt to teach, patient,
text_la: Servum autem Domini non oportet litigare : sed mansuetum esse ad omnes, docibilem, patientem,
text_pt: E ao servo do Senhor não convém contender, mas sim, ser manso para com todos, apto para ensinar, sofredor;
text_el: δοῦλον δὲ κυρίου οὐ δεῖ μάχεσθαι, ἀλλὰ ἤπιον εἶναι πρὸς πάντας, διδακτικόν, ἀνεξίκακον,

text_en: with modesty admonishing them that resist the truth : if peradventure God may give them repentance to know the truth ;
text_la: cum modestia corripientem eos qui resistunt veritati, nequando Deus det illis pœnitentiam ad cognoscendam veritatem,
text_pt: Instruindo com mansidão os que resistem, a ver se porventura Deus lhes dará arrependimento para conhecerem a verdade,
text_el: ἐν πραΰτητι παιδεύοντα τοὺς ἀντιδιατιθεμένους, μήποτε δώῃ αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς μετάνοιαν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας,

text_en: and they may recover themselves from the snares of the devil by whom they are held captive at his will .
text_la: et resipiscant a diaboli laqueis, a quo captivi tenentur ad ipsius voluntatem.
text_pt: E tornarem a despertar, desprendendo-se dos laços do diabo, em que à vontade dele estão presos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνανήψωσιν ἐκ τῆς τοῦ διαβόλου παγίδος, ἐζωγρημένοι ὑπ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἐκείνου θέλημα.

text_en: Know also this, that in the last days shall come dangerous times.
text_la: Hoc autem scito, quod in novissimis diebus instabunt tempora periculosa:
text_pt: Sabe, porém, isto: que nos últimos dias sobrevirão tempos trabalhosos.
text_el: Τοῦτο δὲ γίνωσκε, ὅτι ἐν ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις ἐνστήσονται καιροὶ χαλεποί:

text_en: Men shall be lovers of themselves, covetous , haughty, proud , blasphemers , disobedient to parents , ungrateful, wicked ,
text_la: erunt homines seipsos amantes, cupidi, elati, superbi, blasphemi, parentibus non obedientes, ingrati, scelesti,
text_pt: Porque haverá homens amantes de si mesmos, avarentos, presunçosos, soberbos, blasfemos, desobedientes a pais e mães, ingratos, profanos,
text_el: ἔσονται γὰρ οἱ ἄνθρωποι φίλαυτοι, φιλάργυροι, ἀλαζόνες, ὑπερήφανοι, βλάσφημοι, γονεῦσιν ἀπειθεῖς, ἀχάριστοι, ἀνόσιοι,

text_en: without affection, without peace, slanderers , incontinent, unmerciful, without kindness,
text_la: sine affectione, sine pace, criminatores, incontinentes, immites, sine benignitate,
text_pt: Sem afeto natural, irreconciliáveis, caluniadores, incontinentes, cruéis, sem amor para com os bons,
text_el: ἄστοργοι, ἄσπονδοι, διάβολοι, ἀκρατεῖς, ἀνήμεροι, ἀφιλάγαθοι,

text_en: traitors, stubborn, puffed up , and lovers of pleasure more than of God :
text_la: proditores, protervi, tumidi, et voluptatum amatores magis quam Dei:
text_pt: Traidores, obstinados, orgulhosos, mais amigos dos deleites do que amigos de Deus,
text_el: προδόται, προπετεῖς, τετυφωμένοι, φιλήδονοι μᾶλλον ἢ φιλόθεοι,

text_en: Having an appearance indeed of godliness but denying the power thereof. Now these avoid.
text_la: habentes speciem quidem pietatis, virtutem autem ejus abnegantes. Et hos devita:
text_pt: Tendo aparência de piedade, mas negando a eficácia dela. Destes afasta-te.
text_el: ἔχοντες μόρφωσιν εὐσεβείας τὴν δὲ δύναμιν αὐτῆς ἠρνημένοι: καὶ τούτους ἀποτρέπου.

text_en: For of these sort are they who creep into houses and lead captive silly women laden with sins , who are led away with divers desires:
text_la: ex his enim sunt qui penetrant domos, et captivas ducunt mulierculas oneratas peccatis, quæ ducuntur variis desideriis:
text_pt: Porque deste número são os que se introduzem pelas casas, e levam cativas mulheres néscias carregadas de pecados, levadas de várias concupiscências;
text_el: ἐκ τούτων γάρ εἰσιν οἱ ἐνδύνοντες εἰς τὰς οἰκίας καὶ αἰχμαλωτίζοντες γυναικάρια σεσωρευμένα ἁμαρτίαις, ἀγόμενα ἐπιθυμίαις ποικίλαις,

text_en: Ever learning, and never attaining to the knowledge of the truth .
text_la: semper discentes, et numquam ad scientiam veritatis pervenientes.
text_pt: Que aprendem sempre, e nunca podem chegar ao conhecimento da verdade.
text_el: πάντοτε μανθάνοντα καὶ μηδέποτε εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν δυνάμενα.

text_en: Now as Jannes and Mambres resisted Moses , so these also resist the truth , men corrupted in mind , reprobate concerning the faith .
text_la: Quemadmodum autem Jannes et Mambres restiterunt Moysi : ita et hi resistunt veritati, homines corrupti mente, reprobi circa fidem;
text_pt: E, como Janes e Jambres resistiram a Moisés, assim também estes resistem à verdade, sendo homens corruptos de entendimento e réprobos quanto à fé.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον δὲ Ἰάννης καὶ Ἰαμβρῆς ἀντέστησαν Μωϋσεῖ, οὕτως καὶ οὗτοι ἀνθίστανται τῇ ἀληθείᾳ, ἄνθρωποι κατεφθαρμένοι τὸν νοῦν, ἀδόκιμοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν:

text_en: But they shall proceed no farther: for their folly shall be manifest to all men , as theirs also was.
text_la: sed ultra non proficient : insipientia enim eorum manifesta erit omnibus, sicut et illorum fuit.
text_pt: Não irão, porém, avante; porque a todos será manifesto o seu desvario, como também o foi o daqueles.
text_el: ἀλλ' οὐ προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ πλεῖον, ἡ γὰρ ἄνοια αὐτῶν ἔκδηλος ἔσται πᾶσιν, ὡς καὶ ἡ ἐκείνων ἐγένετο.

text_en: But you have fully known my doctrine , manner of life, purpose, faith , longsuffering, love , patience,
text_la: Tu autem assecutus es meam doctrinam, institutionem, propositum, fidem, longanimitatem, dilectionem, patientiam,
text_pt: Tu, porém, tens seguido a minha doutrina, modo de viver, intenção, fé, longanimidade, amor, paciência,
text_el: Σὺ δὲ παρηκολούθησάς μου τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ, τῇ ἀγωγῇ, τῇ προθέσει, τῇ πίστει, τῇ μακροθυμίᾳ, τῇ ἀγάπῃ, τῇ ὑπομονῇ,

text_en: persecutions , afflictions: such as came upon me at Antioch , at Iconium and at Lystra : what persecutions I endured, and out of them all the Lord delivered me.
text_la: persecutiones, passiones : qualia mihi facta sunt Antiochiæ, Iconii, et Lystris : quales persecutiones sustinui, et ex omnibus eripuit me Dominus.
text_pt: Perseguições e aflições tais quais me aconteceram em Antioquia, em Icônio, e em Listra; quantas perseguições sofri, e o Senhor de todas me livrou;
text_el: τοῖς διωγμοῖς, τοῖς παθήμασιν, οἷά μοι ἐγένετο ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ, ἐν Ἰκονίῳ, ἐν Λύστροις: οἵους διωγμοὺς ὑπήνεγκα, καὶ ἐκ πάντων με ἐρρύσατο ὁ κύριος.

text_en: And all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution .
text_la: Et omnes, qui pie volunt vivere in Christo Jesu, persecutionem patientur.
text_pt: E também todos os que piamente querem viver em Cristo Jesus padecerão perseguições.
text_el: καὶ πάντες δὲ οἱ θέλοντες ζῆν εὐσεβῶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διωχθήσονται.

text_en: But evil men and seducers shall grow worse and worse: erring , and driving into error ,
text_la: Mali autem homines et seductores proficient in pejus, errantes, et in errorem mittentes.
text_pt: Mas os homens maus e enganadores irão de mal para pior, enganando e sendo enganados.
text_el: Πονηροὶ δὲ ἄνθρωποι καὶ γόητες προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ τὸ χεῖρον, πλανῶντες καὶ πλανώμενοι.

text_en: but continue in those things which you have learned and which have been committed to you. Knowing of whom you have learned them:
text_la: Tu vero permane in iis quæ didicisti, et credita sunt tibi : sciens a quo didiceris:
text_pt: Tu, porém, permanece naquilo que aprendeste, e de que foste inteirado, sabendo de quem o tens aprendido,
text_el: σὺ δὲ μένε ἐν οἷς ἔμαθες καὶ ἐπιστώθης, εἰδὼς παρὰ τίνων ἔμαθες,

text_en: And because from your infancy you have known the holy scriptures which can instruct you to salvation by the faith which is in Christ Jesus .
text_la: et quia ab infantia sacras litteras nosti, quæ te possunt instruere ad salutem, per fidem quæ est in Christo Jesu.
text_pt: E que desde a tua meninice sabes as sagradas Escrituras, que podem fazer-te sábio para a salvação, pela fé que há em Cristo Jesus.
text_el: καὶ ὅτι ἀπὸ βρέφους ἱερὰ γράμματα οἶδας, τὰ δυνάμενά σε σοφίσαι εἰς σωτηρίαν διὰ πίστεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: All scripture , inspired of God , is profitable to teach, to reprove, to correct, to instruct in justice :
text_la: Omnis Scriptura divinitus inspirata utilis est ad docendum, ad arguendum, ad corripiendum, et erudiendum in justitia:
text_pt: Toda a Escritura é divinamente inspirada, e proveitosa para ensinar, para redargüir, para corrigir, para instruir em justiça;
text_el: πᾶσα γραφὴ θεόπνευστος καὶ ὠφέλιμος πρὸς διδασκαλίαν, πρὸς ἐλεγμόν, πρὸς ἐπανόρθωσιν, πρὸς παιδείαν τὴν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ,

text_en: That the man of God may be perfect , furnished to every good work .
text_la: ut perfectus sit homo Dei, ad omne opus bonum instructus.
text_pt: Para que o homem de Deus seja perfeito, e perfeitamente instruído para toda a boa obra.
text_el: ἵνα ἄρτιος ᾖ ὁ τοῦ θεοῦ ἄνθρωπος, πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἐξηρτισμένος.

text_en: I charge you, before God and Jesus Christ , who shall judge the living and the dead, by his coming and his kingdom :
text_la: Testificor coram Deo, et Jesu Christo, qui judicaturus est vivos et mortuos, per adventum ipsius, et regnum ejus:
text_pt: Conjuro-te, pois, diante de Deus, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, que há de julgar os vivos e os mortos, na sua vinda e no seu reino,
text_el: Διαμαρτύρομαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, τοῦ μέλλοντος κρίνειν ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς, καὶ τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ:

text_en: Preach the word: be instant in season, out of season: reprove, entreat, rebuke in all patience and doctrine .
text_la: prædica verbum, insta opportune, importune : argue, obsecra, increpa in omni patientia, et doctrina.
text_pt: Que pregues a palavra, instes a tempo e fora de tempo, redarguas, repreendas, exortes, com toda a longanimidade e doutrina.
text_el: κήρυξον τὸν λόγον, ἐπίστηθι εὐκαίρως ἀκαίρως, ἔλεγξον, ἐπιτίμησον, παρακάλεσον, ἐν πάσῃ μακροθυμίᾳ καὶ διδαχῇ.

text_en: For there shall be a time when they will not endure sound doctrine but, according to their own desires, they will heap to themselves teachers having itching ears:
text_la: Erit enim tempus, cum sanam doctrinam non sustinebunt, sed ad sua desideria coacervabunt sibi magistros, prurientes auribus,
text_pt: Porque virá tempo em que não suportarão a sã doutrina; mas, tendo comichão nos ouvidos, amontoarão para si doutores conforme as suas próprias concupiscências;
text_el: ἔσται γὰρ καιρὸς ὅτε τῆς ὑγιαινούσης διδασκαλίας οὐκ ἀνέξονται, ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας ἑαυτοῖς ἐπισωρεύσουσιν διδασκάλους κνηθόμενοι τὴν ἀκοήν,

text_en: And will indeed turn away their hearing from the truth , but will be turned unto fables.
text_la: et a veritate quidem auditum avertent, ad fabulas autem convertentur.
text_pt: E desviarão os ouvidos da verdade, voltando às fábulas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ μὲν τῆς ἀληθείας τὴν ἀκοὴν ἀποστρέψουσιν, ἐπὶ δὲ τοὺς μύθους ἐκτραπήσονται.

text_en: But be vigilant, labour in all things, do the work of an evangelist , fulfil your ministry . Be sober.
text_la: Tu vero vigila, in omnibus labora, opus fac evangelistæ, ministerium tuum imple. Sobrius esto.
text_pt: Mas tu, sê sóbrio em tudo, sofre as aflições, faze a obra de um evangelista, cumpre o teu ministério.
text_el: σὺ δὲ νῆφε ἐν πᾶσιν, κακοπάθησον, ἔργον ποίησον εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὴν διακονίαν σου πληροφόρησον.

text_en: For I am even now ready to be sacrificed : and the time of my dissolution is at hand.
text_la: Ego enim jam delibor, et tempus resolutionis meæ instat.
text_pt: Porque eu já estou sendo oferecido por aspersão de sacrifício, e o tempo da minha partida está próximo.
text_el: ἐγὼ γὰρ ἤδη σπένδομαι, καὶ ὁ καιρὸς τῆς ἀναλύσεώς μου ἐφέστηκεν.

text_en: I have fought a good fight: I have finished my course: I have kept the faith .
text_la: Bonum certamen certavi, cursum consummavi, fidem servavi.
text_pt: Combati o bom combate, acabei a carreira, guardei a fé.
text_el: τὸν καλὸν ἀγῶνα ἠγώνισμαι, τὸν δρόμον τετέλεκα, τὴν πίστιν τετήρηκα:

text_en: As to the rest, there is laid up for me a crown of justice which the Lord the just judge will render to me in that day: and not only to me, but to them also that love his coming. Make haste to come to me quickly.
text_la: In reliquo reposita est mihi corona justitiæ, quam reddet mihi Dominus in illa die, justus judex : non solum autem mihi, sed et iis, qui diligunt adventum ejus. Festina ad me venire cito.
text_pt: Desde agora, a coroa da justiça me está guardada, a qual o Senhor, justo juiz, me dará naquele dia; e não somente a mim, mas também a todos os que amarem a sua vinda.
text_el: λοιπὸν ἀπόκειταί μοι ὁ τῆς δικαιοσύνης στέφανος, ὃν ἀποδώσει μοι ὁ κύριος ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ, ὁ δίκαιος κριτής, οὐ μόνον δὲ ἐμοὶ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἠγαπηκόσι τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: For Demas has left me, loving this world, and has gone to Thessalonica :
text_la: Demas enim me reliquit, diligens hoc sæculum, et abiit Thessalonicam:
text_pt: Procura vir ter comigo depressa,
text_el: Σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρός με ταχέως:

text_en: Crescens into Galatia, Titus into Dalmatia .
text_la: Crescens in Galatiam, Titus in Dalmatiam.
text_pt: Porque Demas me desamparou, amando o presente século, e foi para Tessalônica, Crescente para Galácia, Tito para Dalmácia.
text_el: Δημᾶς γάρ με ἐγκατέλειπεν ἀγαπήσας τὸν νῦν αἰῶνα, καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς Θεσσαλονίκην, Κρήσκης εἰς Γαλατίαν, Τίτος εἰς Δαλματίαν:

text_en: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you: for he is profitable to me for the ministry .
text_la: Lucas est mecum solus. Marcum assume, et adduc tecum : est enim mihi utilis in ministerium.
text_pt: Só Lucas está comigo. Toma Marcos, e traze-o contigo, porque me é muito útil para o ministério.
text_el: Λουκᾶς ἐστιν μόνος μετ' ἐμοῦ. Μᾶρκον ἀναλαβὼν ἄγε μετὰ σεαυτοῦ, ἔστιν γάρ μοι εὔχρηστος εἰς διακονίαν.

text_en: But Tychicus I have sent to Ephesus .
text_la: Tychicum autem misi Ephesum.
text_pt: Também enviei Tíquico a Éfeso.
text_el: Τυχικὸν δὲ ἀπέστειλα εἰς Ἔφεσον.

text_en: The cloak that I left at Troas , with Carpus, when you come, bring with you: and the books, especially the parchments.
text_la: Penulam, quam reliqui Troade apud Carpum, veniens affer tecum, et libros, maxime autem membranas.
text_pt: Quando vieres, traze a capa que deixei em Trôade, em casa de Carpo, e os livros, principalmente os pergaminhos.
text_el: τὸν φαιλόνην, ὃν ἀπέλειπον ἐν Τρῳάδι παρὰ Κάρπῳ, ἐρχόμενος φέρε, καὶ τὰ βιβλία, μάλιστα τὰς μεμβράνας.

text_en: Alexander the coppersmith has done me much evil : the Lord will reward him according to his works :
text_la: Alexander ærarius multa mala mihi ostendit : reddet illi Dominus secundum opera ejus:
text_pt: Alexandre, o latoeiro, causoume muitos males; o Senhor lhe pague segundo as suas obras.
text_el: Ἀλέξανδρος ὁ χαλκεὺς πολλά μοι κακὰ ἐνεδείξατο: ἀποδώσει αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ:

text_en: Whom also avoid: for he has greatly withstood our words.
text_la: quem et tu devita : valde enim restitit verbis nostris.
text_pt: Tu, guarda-te também dele, porque resistiu muito às nossas palavras.
text_el: ὃν καὶ σὺ φυλάσσου, λίαν γὰρ ἀντέστη τοῖς ἡμετέροις λόγοις.

text_en: At my first answer, no man stood with me: but all forsook me. May it not be laid to their charge!
text_la: In prima mea defensione nemo mihi affuit, sed omnes me dereliquerunt : non illis imputetur.
text_pt: Ninguém me assistiu na minha primeira defesa, antes todos me desampararam. Que isto lhes não seja imputado.
text_el: ἐν τῇ πρώτῃ μου ἀπολογίᾳ οὐδείς μοι παρεγένετο, ἀλλὰ πάντες με ἐγκατέλειπον: μὴ αὐτοῖς λογισθείη:

text_en: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that by me the preaching may be accomplished and that all the Gentiles may hear. And I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
text_la: Dominus autem mihi astitit, et confortavit me, ut per me prædicatio impleatur, et audiant omnes gentes : et liberatus sum de ore leonis.
text_pt: Mas o Senhor assistiu-me e fortaleceu-me, para que por mim fosse cumprida a pregação, e todos os gentios a ouvissem; e fiquei livre da boca do leão.
text_el: ὁ δὲ κύριός μοι παρέστη καὶ ἐνεδυνάμωσέν με, ἵνα δι' ἐμοῦ τὸ κήρυγμα πληροφορηθῇ καὶ ἀκούσωσιν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ ἐρρύσθην ἐκ στόματος λέοντος.

text_en: The Lord has delivered me from every evil work and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom . To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen .
text_la: Liberavit me Dominus ab omni opere malo : et salvum faciet in regnum suum cæleste, cui gloria in sæcula sæculorum. Amen.
text_pt: E o Senhor me livrará de toda a má obra, e guardar-me-á para o seu reino celestial; a quem seja glória para todo o sempre. Amém.
text_el: ῥύσεταί με ὁ κύριος ἀπὸ παντὸς ἔργου πονηροῦ καὶ σώσει εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐπουράνιον, ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων: ἀμήν.

text_en: Salute Prisca and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.
text_la: Saluta Priscam, et Aquilam, et Onesiphori domum.
text_pt: Saúda a Prisca e a Áqüila, e à casa de Onesíforo.
text_el: Ἄσπασαι Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν καὶ τὸν Ὀνησιφόρου οἶκον.

text_en: Erastus remained at Corinth . And Trophimus I left sick at Miletus .
text_la: Erastus remansit Corinthi. Trophimum autem reliqui infirmum Mileti.
text_pt: Erasto ficou em Corinto, e deixei Trófimo doente em Mileto.
text_el: Ἔραστος ἔμεινεν ἐν Κορίνθῳ, Τρόφιμον δὲ ἀπέλειπον ἐν Μιλήτῳ ἀσθενοῦντα.

text_en: Make haste to come before winter. Eubulus and Pudens and Linus and Claudia and all the brethren, salute you.
text_la: Festina ante hiemem venire. Salutant te Eubulus, et Pudens, et Linus, et Claudia, et fratres omnes.
text_pt: Procura vir antes do inverno. Eubulo, e Prudente, e Lino, e Cláudia, e todos os irmãos te saúdam.
text_el: σπούδασον πρὸ χειμῶνος ἐλθεῖν. ἀσπάζεταί σε Εὔβουλος καὶ Πούδης καὶ Λίνος καὶ Κλαυδία καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ [πάντες].

text_en: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit . Grace be with you. Amen .
text_la: Dominus Jesus Christus cum spiritu tuo. Gratia vobiscum. Amen.
text_pt: O Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com o teu espírito. A graça seja convosco. Amém.
text_el: Ὁ κύριος μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματός σου. ἡ χάρις μεθ' ὑμῶν.
